title: Block=Death
description: When you make contact with a random block, you die.
body:
When you step or make contact with a random block, you die. With the hotkey, b, it allows you to randomize the block that when contacted, you die, you can also reveal the block, and another feature, when you die, your world gets deleted.

This can be a fun prank for your friends, since it only needs to be on the server side to work, to access to menu, you need to be a op and have the mod installed, or you can just play this with the upside of the risk.
